tasks.name: Research Runtime Engine
tasks.responsibility: Advance the Research Operating System state machine by exactly one governed transition per eligible object.
tasks.output: Governed lifecycle transition and durable research artifact

tasks.name: Research Runtime Queue
tasks.responsibility: Discover signals, score candidates, assign every selected object to one of the three research columns, and publish the daily column plan.
tasks.output: Research Queue and three-column Daily Research Plan

tasks.name: Research Runtime Knowledge
tasks.responsibility: Admit evidence-validated Research Notes into Knowledge, maintain relationships and register architecture candidates.
tasks.output: Knowledge records, links and architecture candidates

tasks.name: Research Runtime Architecture
tasks.responsibility: Review architecture candidates and make governed Architecture, Specification, Publication and lifecycle decisions.
prohibitions: Architecture decision from a single unsupported observation

tasks.name: Research Runtime Production
tasks.responsibility: Consume eligible analyzed objects by column and execute Research Writing, Visualization, Evidence and Citation, and Publication Editing to create complete bilingual Publication Candidates.

tasks.name: Research Runtime Publication
tasks.responsibility: Release only complete Publication Candidates, update bilingual indexes and website surfaces, commit to GitHub, and verify the commit.
tasks.output: Released Daily Research and verified GitHub publication

tasks.name: Research Runtime Weekly
tasks.responsibility: Produce cross-analysis, architecture judgment, engineering judgment and a genuinely new Weekly Synthesis.

tasks.name: Research Runtime Academic
tasks.responsibility: Research and publish papers, benchmarks, specifications, conferences and institutions through the complete Research Skills pipeline.
